received_works.body:
こんにちは！
いつも素敵な絵をありがとうございます！

今回はTRPG用のKP駒立ち絵をお願いしたいです。
見た目はふわふわの白いポメラニアンで基本的に内容はお任せです。
お時間ありましたらよろしくお願いします！

Hello, my name is so and so.
I am sending you a request to be placed on the board as a KP character for a TRPG.
I would like a girl with a wolf motif, one white and one black, each designed as a twin. The clothes should be white Lolita or Gothic Lolita style, with dog ears and tail would be great. It would also be helpful if the facial expressions are in contrast to ☺️😐.
I know this is a very vague request, but I would appreciate it if you could give it some thought.
Thank you in advance.

Hello! Your chibi illustrations are so cute, I would love if you drew my character, Soyuu. She's shy corrupted angel. Soyuu has blue hair , a black halo and wings and she wears a white fluffy dress with a black harness . She also has a pet Bee who you can add if you would like. For the pose could you have her flying with a leaf glider like the reference, with a mushroom hat if possible.

For use on sns/Youtube/Twitch. Thank you for considering my request~

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1O5jcmrVknZmbhbaFXpgrl0k8fFkJJex3?usp=sharing

Hello! Your illustrations are very beautiful! I love your chibi character illustrations! I wanted to request for you to draw my Vtuber character.

She is a mermaid princess, and she has seashell pupils in her eyes, and small pink scales on her body. She is cheerful, but not very smart. She is also a yumejoshi and she loves games, anime, and manga! Her motifs are seashells and fish.

Instead of her normal outfit, she would be wearing this outfit: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1y4VhnlW7Mr49UGXQlV5pFfnCV9LPIYIb/view?usp=sharing

She would still be wearing her usual beret and glasses.

If possible, I would like a transparent png file of the drawing as well for use on social media (Twitter, Twitch, Youtube). 
Thank you very much! I would be very happy if you accepted this request.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1tJ2WlcDiThvjsb8jFBh0BrCRxmnV3Bh0?usp=sharing

Hello!

May I request 2 separate chibis of my OC in different forms?
One will be the human form, and one will be the cat form (see "cat_form.png" for idea)

My OC is a former pirate who loves to drink beer with friends.
He's also very mischievous and loves to play pranks on friends.
If possible, please draw with both eyes open.
Please use the pirate clothes.
I'll leave everything else up to you.

Thank you for considering!

https://app.box.com/s/gu8942f47x8m4ln2ayn6ml41e2uj0b7v

Hello!

Your art is very soft and cute! 

Please consider drawing my FFXIV OC in your style. Her face always looks like she's tired of everyone and everything but she's actually a big softy and only complains to complain but will still help out.

Thank you for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1i1N8t3uWFKAMe-huwA8uPNNqL7mZ36n5/view?usp=sharing

Hello! Your art is so beautiful! I would like to request a full body chibi artwork of my character!
She live among the clouds. She is gentle and elegant. She has wing ears and golden eyes with a blossom shape. Pose is up to you!
Can you also provide a transparent png?

And if you would like, if you could do a happy and neutral expression? It's okay if not!
Please draw freely! I hope you consider my request. Thank you!

https://imgur.com/a/fOzg04G

Hello!! I love your art style. I wanted to request artwork for myself and my boyfriend Peas, whos birthday is on April 30th!

Lunaaa is a very energetic human who likes outer space, roses, and splatoon.

Peas is also a very energetic human but is usually calm. He likes sonic, super monkey ball, and cares about Lunaaa a lot.

I would like them sitting next to eachother playing on seperate nintendo switches.
Please make Lunaaa's Joycons Pink (Left Side) and Yellow (Right Side)
Please also make Peas' Joycons Purple (Left Side) and Blue (Right Side)

Please include a version with your usual photo size, and a twitter banner version (1500x500)
Everything else is up to you!
Thank you!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1P8Eyjp-C8kh5xFKzznEdMTLFerbGZVVe?usp=share_link

Hello! 
Your SD is adorable! 
Please consider drawing my FF14 OC as SD and making a cute happy pose!

Hair: Silver gray
Eye: Pink
FF14 race: au'ra

Thank you!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/17eiIeRmL26M6DYi701s1ccHM-p0aqkNY?usp=share_link

Hello, I would like to request an artwork of my original character. She is a demon sheep girl who became a priestess. I would like to use the illustration for my social media (youtube, twitch, twitter).

If possible, I would like to request the photoshop file with character, background, signature separated.

The pose is up to you, please use the short hair version of my character!

Reference: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1u0Lo2zu96anXqQKN9gDtpt857UCDdoTL/view?usp=sharing
Hair style reference: https://drive.google.com/drive/u/3/folders/1TJDw05B_rM-JhJCprkWF2VVcZstXInFG

Hi,
I love your art style. Can you draw my VTuber character? She is a pink haired bunny girl with a love for bread, pastries and of course Anime. She collects anime figurines, manga and games.  She can be ditzy at times, but she has a big heart. 

The pose, expression, and background are up to you

I plan to post this on SNS. If possible, can you include a PSD file with separate layers.
 
Thank you,

Here is the character reference sheet:
https://i.imgur.com/AvASFPT

I'd like to leave the pose and style up to you.

https://imgur.com/OhrhERh

Your chibi art is very cute. My character is a "Newman" from the "Phantasy Star" games.

Black Ponytail
White blind eye

Request:
Chibi
Simple pose
Clothes: https://i.imgur.com/9I4igId.png

Hello!
I was attracted by the sample image.
I was attracted by the sample image, and I would like to request Amayuri to draw it for me!
I was especially attracted by the suspended eyes that you drew...

I would like to use it as my original avatar*1 for a live-streaming video for my group of friends.
I would like to use it as a chibi character.

The composition of the character is similar to the one I fell in love with at first sight, "https://skeb.jp/@rainlily_00/works/90".
I would be happy if you could design cute clothes for me to wear!

Reference materials
With an original character based on a rabbit motif
I'm imagining a cheerful little girl with suspicions in her eyes!
I'm sorry that the pupils are so small that they are hard to see.
I have added a cross pattern*2 in the pupil, so I would be very grateful if you could help me with the illustration as well!

*1 Reference image
https://twitter.com/Eclipse__Group/status/1549692587660808192?s=20&t=Vv4l_MELni8V__7vRsOCJQ
2 Reference image
https://twitter.com/Eclipse__Group/status/1549694962907770880?s=20&t=Vv4l_MELni8V__7vRsOCJQ

If there is room in the budget
If you can spare the budget, I would be very happy if you could provide me with facial expressions as well!
If it's too much, please feel free to decline!

Hello! Your art is very cute. I would be happy if you consider my request and draw two original characters in your style:

Character A:  150cm. A magician who cannot express emotions well. She is very serious about studying, and spends most of her time alone reading books or working. Awkward around other people, but wants to be closer to them. 

Character B: 152cm. A goddess who likes chaos. She is in a contractual relationship with Character A, and is always involved in mischief. This character appears from the shadows and has a sharp smile. 

Thank you very much for your consideration!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1UKnGdIq-G_bHO-Z_QaKM0KXfndMRTCTn?usp=sharing

Hi your art is so cute! If you accept could you please draw this boy? https://sta.sh/2tx4r7c5qkd

He's a nurse and is mischievous

thank you!

Amayuri, nice to meet you! I enjoyed looking at your beautiful drawings. I am attracted by your cute drawings and would like to request Amayuri to deform my own character if possible.

Request Details
Please see the following URL for character and clothing references. We are two senior and junior members of the elven tribe who serve at the shrine. We have known each other for a long time, so we are very close now.

[1
Junior (short-haired girl, 177cm). She has a kind and calm personality on the outside, but inside she is a bit tsundere and a bit cheeky. She is a caring person. Her right eye is brown and her left eye is blue.

[2
Senpai (pony-tailed girl, 5'8"). She is cool and quiet on the front and shy on the back. He is kind of a pain in the ass because he is always being taken care of by others. Please wear ear ornaments only on the left ear.

If possible, please do one illustration with a spring motif with these two. We would be very happy if you could draw them in a friendly atmosphere. We would like to leave the rest of the poses and composition to Amayuri, so please feel free to draw them!

If there are any difficulties or problems with the request, by all means, please decline.
Thank you for your consideration.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1qfI9btETSqer4D3GMUatUftJrYDAlWxQ?usp=sharing

Hello!! ^-^ I really love your chibi style. Can you draw my hime vtuber?
With your permission, I'd love to use this on my twitch with full credit to you :D

https://drive.google.com/file/d/1iPhat8pLSyeOrJL9Oefj7ocOjvg725Lv/view?usp=drivesdk

Amayuri-san,

I realized that I had accidentally cancelled my request. I am so sorry about that!

I would like to request a drawing of my character. She is a cat maid that works at a tea house. Please draw her as you like, but I would if it showed her full body.

Thank you very much!

https://imgur.com/a/njkAnIi

Hello my favorite chibi artist! I would love to get another chibi done of my Vtuber to use for my stinger transition. I would love it to be the outfit in the reference and I would like her to be in this pose:

Hello! I really like your art and I'd like to commission you multiple chibis if possible!!

Could you draw my  character doing different poses as followed :

- Saying hello waving with a hand.
- Reading a book with "Rules" written on it.
- Peeking out of a table with a frog on her head.
- Holding the discord Logo.
- Having money in her hand with sunglasses.

Could you provide each one of them without any background in transparent PNG and PSD?

Here are the references!! If my request is not suitable please feel free to decline it!

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1CWjPzsinEFzNPHYG6rXCq430UI9y8790?usp=sharing

Hello! I would like to request a work of art in which my friend is holding a stuffed animal of Baku. I've attached a reference URL for the other character. I'll leave the pose up to you, but I might use it for my profile picture on social media. 

I would like a picture of character saying, "Study Japanese.” (Please write it in Japanese characters) It would be great if you could prepare one with and one without the characters. Thank you very much.

https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/841098076340486154/913190402947956768/1272810_FEhudb6f.png

Hello, I think your chibi art is very cute! I would like to request a chibi illustration of my two original characters. Please refer to the link at the bottom for references.

🌅 Character A details. Male. 185cm. 32 years old. Wavy black hair. Hazel eyes. He is a cheerful and outgoing person. He wears a priest outfit.

🌌 Character B details. Male. 180cm. 28 years old. Black hair. Dark blue eyes. He is a calm person with a stoic face. He wears normal clothes.

Please draw the both of them holding hands.

Thank you! Please feel free to reject if you do not feel comfortable with the request.

https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/112JVeBhvsUu1f7YTf6VqCnjG7NToUkfJ

Hello again!
I would love a chibi drawing of this couple again!
I would love for them to be kissing under the mistletoe.
I would love it to be very Christmas-themed.
I love your art so I am really excited about this!
Thank you!
